traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report contains two relative trueness studies: (1) the initial validation with 2 dilutions (Table 3, page 12/91) used here as the primary/canonical study, and (2) an extension study using a single dilution/plate (Table 12, page 27/91), which gave similar but slightly different values (e.g. Meat products n=16, bias 0.02, SD 0.09, LCL -0.17, UCL 0.20; Dairy n=15, bias 0.03, SD 0.12, LCL -0.23, UCL 0.30; Seafood n=18, bias 0.05, SD 0.14, LCL -0.26, UCL 0.36; Vegetal n=15, bias 0.01, SD 0.15, LCL -0.31, UCL 0.34; RTE/RTRH n=15, bias 0.01, SD 0.12, LCL -0.25, UCL 0.26). The 'All categories' aggregate rows from both tables (n=89, bias 0.03 for two-dilution study; n=79, bias 0.02 for single-dilution study) were excluded per instructions. The Acceptability Limit of ±0.5 log10 CFU/g is stated multiple times throughout the report (e.g. accuracy profile tables and interlaboratory study conclusion).
